done.why: The egg is in the trophy case, which was my goal.

about: A reworked Zork-like start: a white house, a tree with a jewelled egg, a cellar with a troll, and a trophy case in the living room. The goal was to get the egg into the case.

ending.what: The jewel-encrusted egg was in the trophy case, confirmed by looking in the case.

moments.note: Died to the troll after a few sword swings and was sent to the forest with empty hands.
Could not take the leaflet after opening the mailbox.
My things were scattered after death: the sack was in the forest and the bottle behind the house.
The egg was in the nest in the tree, and putting it in the case worked at once.

wished: Explore the cellar and beyond past the troll.
A clearer map of the forest, whose exits were confusing.

lines.line: It appears that that last blow was too much for you. I'm afraid you are dead.
lines.why: The troll fight was lethal and quick.

lines.line: Your collection of treasures consists of: A jewel-encrusted egg
lines.why: This confirmed the goal was met.

fun.why: A short, easy goal, with a sudden death along the way.

engagement.why: It was quick to complete, so I did little exploring.

difficulty.why: Once I thought of the tree, the egg was simple to get.

interestingness.why: It is familiar, with small changes such as the glowing sword and the scattered items.

prose.why: The descriptions are clear and familiar.
